import math

def r(x):
    return x / 2.0

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    e_orig = abs(y_orig - 1.0)
    e_new = abs(y_new - 1.0)
    if e_orig == 0.0:
        return e_new == 0.0
    if e_new == 0.0:
        return True
    ratio = e_new / e_orig
    if ratio <= 0.0:
        return False
    slope = math.log(ratio) / math.log(0.5)
    return abs(slope - 2.0) <= 0.2
